predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: the French colony of Upper Volta, re-established 'with its previous boundaries' on 4 September 1947 and an autonomous republic in the French Community from 11 December 1958

ledger.x: 5 August 1960: Upper Volta becomes fully independent from France.
4 August 1984: Upper Volta becomes Burkina Faso.
25 December 1985: Mali and Burkina Faso fight over the Agacher Strip.
22 December 1986: the ICJ ends the Agacher dispute.
22 December 1986: the western part of the Agacher Strip goes to Mali.

wars.name: Agacher Strip War
wars.outcome: Ceasefire on 30 December 1985 after five days (25-30 December); the ICJ divided the strip on 22 December 1986, Mali taking the western portion and Burkina Faso the eastern section around the Beli.

wars.name: Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso
wars.outcome: Ongoing: 'A Jihadist insurgency began in August 2015'; 'about 60% of the country under government control' in 2022 after the January coup; the government claimed to have recaptured 40% in 2023, while the bishop of Dori claimed 'around 50% of the country was…

certainty.note: The page says the Franco-British Convention of 14 June 1898 created the modern borders; the Agacher Strip stretch with Mali was uncertain until the ICJ ruling of 22 December 1986 (soft there before 1987).
